mapper.select: select s.schedule_id, s.user_id, u.user_name, s.dept_id, d.dept_name, s.work_date, s.shift_id, sh.shift_name, s.rest_type, s.schedule_remark from hr_schedule s left join sys_user u on u.user_id = s.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = s.dept_id left join hr_shift sh on sh.shift_id = s.shift_id where s.schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
mapper.insert: insert into hr_schedule(user_id, dept_id, work_date, shift_id, rest_type, schedule_remark, create_by, create_time) values(#{userId}, #{deptId}, #{workDate}, #{shiftId}, #{restType}, #{scheduleRemark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from hr_schedule where schedule_id in #{id}
